meta.title: AgentBridge — Remote MCP HTTP Transport Architecture
meta.subtitle: Streamable HTTP, Legacy SSE Fallback, Connection Lifecycle & Security Controls
meta.description: System architecture of the Phase 7.7 Remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) HTTP Transport in AgentBridge. Illustrates HTTP/HTTPS transport mechanics, modern Streamable HTTP (POST with direct JSON or streaming text/event-stream responses), legacy SSE fallback (GET /sse + POST /messages), authentication injection, bounded buffering, error normalization, and AgentBridge platform boundaries.
